cohort: The study included 1,049 people aged 40 years or more, consisting of 568 individuals with ALS and 481 controls, who responded to an online international questionnaire.
finding: People with ALS were more likely to have been born and lived longer in a country area than in a city area, to have younger parents, and to have lower educational attainment and fewer years of education.
mod_finding: No differences between ALS cases and controls were found regarding Cesarean delivery.
